Strategy: Best Fit scoring plus a single large bonus for an exact fit only, with no other bonuses or bands, so a perfectly fitting bin outranks any merely tight one. The ranking differs from Best Fit only when an exact-fit bin exists and is not already tightest. It may help by harvesting perfect fits without distorting other choices, or fail because exact fits are rare and the bonus then never fires.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (200 if r == item else 0)) for r in bins]
```
